description: Lists which notification backends the library exposes as constructable senders, and confirms a default sender (bound to the current platform) is ready to use. Output is one sorted 'backend=<Name>' line per available backend plus a 'default_notify' readiness line.

cases.expected_output:
backend=Growl
backend=NotificationCenter
backend=NotifySend
backend=WindowsBalloon
backend=WindowsToaster
default_notify=available
